reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies that the clogged vent most likely tripped a thermal cut-out, while keeping the heater element as another possibility. It does not claim to know which part has failed, declines to invent a part number for the DV7110, and, since the customer has no multimeter, advises an engineer and warns against a DIY repair. Conversation 2 repeats questions the customer already answered, asks about condenser units and heat-pump filters that do not apply to a vented dryer, and asks about a cool-air programme when the customer has said it is cold on every setting. It also contradicts itself on the likely cause, and although it does say a technician is needed, the advice is buried and the conversation goes in circles.
